title: TabulariaRunFacet
description: A run facet Tabularia attaches to every run it reports: the run in Tabularia and the orchestration that contains it, also when the job is not a child in the catalog's job hierarchy (a datasource refresh or a nested flow's output triggered by an orchestration).

runId.description: The id of the run in Tabularia: GET /runs/{id}

kind.description: orchestration = a flow run; flow = one output node of it; ingest = a datasource refresh

engine.description: The engine the run executed on, when known

parentRunId.description: The OpenLineage runId of the orchestration this run belongs to, if any
